title: Russia and China retrieval teams and the gentleman's agreement
summary: Michael Herrera tells of Russia and China retrieval teams and the gentleman's agreement, about present at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Russia and China have their own retrieval teams of non-human intelligence and they have their own technologies reverse engineered and they're pretty much on par with what we're doing.

plain: A former US Marine named Michael Herrera, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says Russia and China have their own teams for recovering craft made by non-human intelligence, meaning beings that are not us. He says they have reverse engineered, or taken apart and copied, their own technology and are roughly on par with the United States, and the story speaks of a gentleman's agreement among these powers. If true, it would mean a quiet race over alien technology is running between the world's great powers.
